title: glab api projects/${project}/labels?per_page=100 --paginate
description: The project's labels, ${project} its path URL-encoded, whose names and colors kit reads to color the labels of the merge requests and of the issues they close in `modules/bash/forge/gitlab.sh` (forge/gitlab:open-prs), with `modules/jq/forge.jq` (forge::colored); --paginate prints one such array per page. The types are APIEntitiesProjectLabel of GET /api/v4/projects/{id}/labels in GitLab's REST OpenAPI, https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/raw/master/doc/api/openapi/openapi_v3.yaml, as https://docs.gitlab.com/api/labels/ describes it.

color.description: A 6-digit hex color with a leading #, as #d9534f, or a CSS color name.
